_comment: Windows standalone miniQMT targeted-pool bridge (legacy). Trigger URL/key fields are unused in targeted mode; full_market uses them to notify quant-api. For Tushare rt_k replacement copy scripts/qmt/miniqmt_bridge.full_market.example.json instead. Do not run targeted and full_market at the same time. Local scripts/qmt/miniqmt_bridge.json is gitignored. CLI flags override these values.
